Subject: Medivance MAP — deployment mode & regional acceptance (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Per our mutual action plan (attached), I sketched a recommended evaluation and close timeline so we can lock the deployment mode and region for your PoC and initial production window. High level asks from Medivance I remember: EU data residency, SOC2 evidence, and predictable latency under 150ms P95 for the flows you shared.

Proposal summary (short):
- Phase 1 (PoC, 2 weeks): Hosted EU region using our shared-hosted cluster to validate quality & latency with a small sandbox dataset (non-PHI).
- Phase 2 (Pilot, 4 weeks): Dedicated pool in eu-west for encrypted storage + throughput testing (200 req/s baseline).
- Phase 3 (Production): Option to migrate to Private (VPC) if you require on-prem or air-gapped controls; timeline conditional on procurement & SOC2 legal review.

Key timeline (working draft):
- 2026-07-05: Kickoff & access to sandbox
- 2026-07-19: PoC completion & latency report
- 2026-08-02: Pilot start on Dedicated pool
- 2026-09-01: Production cutover (if procurement & legal complete)

Attachments: Medivance_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with owners/dates), hosting_capability_matrix.pdf

Could you confirm: a) whether the above sequencing aligns with Medivance procurement windows, and b) whether we should target eu-west (Ireland) or eu-central (Frankfurt) for the PoC? We can run a short latency check against both.

If that sounds good I’ll schedule the technical kickoff and loop in infra to start reserving capacity.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0168

Markus —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates:

- Data residency: Medivance requires primary data processing and storage in the EU (prefer eu-central if possible).
- Compliance: we’ll need SOC2 Type II report and a DPA with standard EU data processing clauses before pilot.
- Timeline pressure: procurement is running a 6-week window but we may be able to accelerate if we get a pricing commitment for Dedicated earlier.

Can you confirm whether the Hosted PoC will use synthetic or masked production data? Also, can you send the SOC2 evidence and the DPA template?

If you can circulate a short pricing range for the Dedicated pilot (200 req/s baseline) that will help our procurement team decide whether to sign up for reserved capacity versus staying on Hosted for longer.

Thanks — I’ll add procurement to future threads.

Best,
Anika Rao

anika@medivance.com

Hi Anika — quick note from infra/planning side: we ran a short EU-region latency sweep and attached a sample CSV with P50/P95 numbers for the standard gen endpoint. Short recommendation:

- Start with Hosted in eu-central for the PoC (fastest path, lower setup friction).
- Move to Dedicated eu-central for Pilot to validate throughput at 200 req/s with KV cache enabled + disk encryption.
- Private (VPC) option remains available for production if legal requires; lead time ~6 weeks for on-prem/VPC package + KMS integration.

Proposed compressed timeline (we can shave ~2 weeks if procurement signs an LOI):
- 2026-07-02: Kickoff (we can push earlier)
- 2026-07-16: PoC complete + perf report
- 2026-07-30: Pilot starts on Dedicated (reserved capacity staged)
- 2026-08-20: Production readiness checklist complete

Action items for our side:
- Priyom: provide detailed pricing range for Dedicated 200 req/s (attachment follows).
- Laura: prepare SOC2 artifact bundle and DPA template for legal review.
- Markus: coordinate kickoff & calendar with Medivance.

Attachment: redwood_eu_region_latency_metrics.csv
